Definition: Mareshah, the name of two Israelites and of a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Marʼêshâh is the name of two Israelites and of a town in Judah. In 1 Chronicles 2:42 Mareshah is the son of Caleb's brother Jerahmeel and the father of Hebron, and in 2 Chronicles 11:8 Mareshah stands among the fenced cities of Judah. In 2 Chronicles 14:9 Zerah the Ethiopian comes out against Judah as far as Mareshah., and the name is a family line and a fortified place.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Marʼêshâh shows me that one name can belong to a man and a town, and that God keeps both in His record.
